json_schema.title: service.enable
json_schema.description: Enable the named service to start at boot

name.ui:title: Name
name.ui:description: The name of the service to enable

start_type.ui:title: Service start type
start_type.ui:description: Specifies the service start type. Valid options are as follows: 'boot':Device driver that is loaded by the boot loader; 'system':Device driver that is started during kernel initialization; 'auto':Service that automatically starts; 'manual':Service must be started manually; 'disabled':Service cannot be started

start_delayed.ui:title: Delayed Start
start_delayed.ui:description: Set the service to Auto(Delayed Start). Only valid if the start_type is set to Auto. If service_type is not passed, but the service is already set to Auto, then the flag will be set
